title: Renewal, Expiration and Carrier Non-Renewal Provisions — Manufactured Home Insurance
content:
At the end of each 12-month term a Manufactured Home Insurance policy either renews, expires or is non-renewed by the carrier.

## Provisions

**Renewal offer and acceptance.** The renewal offer is issued the form's renewal-offer lead time before the expiration date, at the re-rated premium, and the renewal takes effect when the first installment of the new term is paid on or before the expiration date; otherwise the policy expires. An accepted renewal starts a new term with its own effective date, expiration date and annual premium.

**Carrier non-renewal.** The carrier non-renews when paid claims in the form's claims lookback reach the form's non-renewal claims count, or when the home no longer meets the form's entry gate, with notice at least the form's non-renewal notice period before expiration; a policy with less notice renews once more.

**End of coverage.** A non-renewed or expired policy ends at the expiration date, and a Hearthstone Home Finance loss payee is notified; the insurance status recorded on the Hearthstone home loan becomes lapsed. The policy's end is recorded as the day after the expiration date.

## Acceptance by payment (hypothetical policy expiring 30 September)

| First installment of the new term paid | Result |
|---|---|
| 12 September | The renewal takes effect |
| 30 September (the expiration date) | The renewal takes effect |
| 1 October, or not at all | The policy expires; coverage ends at the expiration date |

## Notice of non-renewal (same hypothetical policy; 45-day notice period)

| Notice mailed | Days of notice before 30 September | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 August | 60 | The policy is non-renewed at expiration |
| 16 August | 45 | The policy is non-renewed at expiration |
| 17 August | 44 | Less notice than required; the policy renews once more |

## Grounds for non-renewal (hypothetical claim counts)

| Paid claims within the claims lookback | Form with a count of 3 | Form with a count of 2 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Count not reached | Count not reached |
| 2 | Count not reached | Count reached |
| 3 | Count reached | Count reached |

Reaching the count, or the home no longer meeting the form's entry gate, is a ground for non-renewal; each still requires notice at least the non-renewal notice period before expiration.
